sources.title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3 · GitHub
sources.snippet: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token. To achieve efficient inference and cost-effective training, DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, which were thoroughly validated in DeepSeek-V2. sources.title: DeepSeek - AI Assistant & V3 Chat
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V3 is a state-of-the-art natural language processing (NLP) model designed for general-purpose conversational AI. It excels in understanding and generating human-like text, making it ideal for chatbots, virtual assistants, and customer support automation.
